task.title: Troubleshoot documentation portal build and link failures
task.shortdesc: Diagnose /help/ build, manifest, search, source-link, and generated-link failures without patching built artifacts.

prereq.p: Use this procedure when make docs-validate, make docs-build, make test-docs-contract, /help/, or generated documentation links fail during source operation or update-from-source checks.

context.p: Documentation portal troubleshooting belongs to source DITA, maps, keys, config, tools, and focused tests. Built output under documentation/build/, reports, manifests, search indexes, and packages are regenerated evidence, not hand-edited source.

step.cmd: Start with the smallest documentation command named by the failure.

info.p: For one changed topic, run make docs-fast-check DOCS_CHANGED="documentation/src/dita/en/admin/example.dita". For contracts, run the named documentation/tests/contract/... file. For full link validation, run make docs-validate.

Source failures usually name a DITA topic, key, or fragment. Generated-link failures appear after DITA publish and can involve manifest, target map, search, or normalized output path. Preserve the failing path and target URL.

step.cmd: Fix source, map, key, config, or generator input only.

info.p: Do not patch documentation/build/, documentation/dist/, documentation/reports/, generated search indexes, or packaged artifacts by hand. Update the DITA topic, map, keydef, config, or build tool, then rebuild.

If the static build passes but BPM /help/ reports missing, stale, incompatible, incomplete, or not-found states, check installed artifact path and manifest digest. Preserve FastAPI /docs and /openapi.json separately.

step.cmd: Record the focused rerun and remaining gates.

info.p: Use make test-docs-contract, make docs-validate, and make docs-build for this troubleshooting slice.
info.note: Browser-backed docs checks, screenshots, manual QA, package verification, and product release tests remain separate gates unless explicitly run.

result.p: The operator can diagnose documentation portal failures from source and regenerate output without hand-editing disposable artifacts.

postreq.p: After the portal build passes, rerun the update-from-source verification topic and any affected contextual help route checks.
